entries.subject: DAMIT 809: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: DAMIT model 809, version 2016-01-04, pole (88°, -43°), period 9.02321 h, taken unchanged from the archive. Mirror solution 810 recorded as an alternative.

entries.subject: Physical scale
entries.finding: 139.39 ± 3 km, effective diameter of a sphere fitted to thermal infrared measurements. JPL lists a diameter of 139.39 ± 3 km, from the IRAS Minor Planet Survey (PDS data set IRAS-A-FPA-3-RDR-IMPS-V6.0). The thermal sphere diameter is transferred to the mesh as its volume-equivalent diameter.

entries.subject: PDS SBN catalogue values that disagree with the factsheet or are not shown
entries.finding: Shown size Display reference radius "69.69 km (size-calibrated model)" (jpl-small-body-database) differs from the Small Bodies Occultations V4.0 record 267, DAMIT model 810 diameter 117 ± 3 km (volume-equivalent; DAMIT model 810 fitted to 1 occultation); the shown value is kept.
entries.revisitWhen: A newer release of the named catalogue, or a review that replaces the shown value.

entries.subject: Comacina whole-disc color
entries.finding: Gaia Collaboration, Galluccio et al. (2023) published the mean of 15 Gaia epoch spectra of the unresolved disc: reflectance against the Sun in 16 bands from 374 to 1034 nm, 1 at 550 nm (0.957 at 462 nm, 1.006 at 638 nm). The shape is painted in that one color (#3b3a38 in sRGB) through the shared disc-integrated-color method, scaled to the 4.3% geometric albedo JPL lists (± 0.2%), from the IRAS Minor Planet Survey (PDS data set IRAS-A-FPA-3-RDR-IMPS-V6.0). It is one mean, not a map. Tinaut-Ruano et al. (2023), A&A 669, L14, found Gaia DR3 reflectances slightly too red at wavelengths shorter than 550 nm; the bands are used as published, without that paper's correction.
